“

A cape inspired by hypothetical covert operatives—pillars of Democratic order, operating in the hostile abyss where Liberty's light cannot yet reach.

— Armory cape description

Pillar of the Abyss is a cape and a player card in Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 Acquisition
  • 2 Change History

Acquisition

This cosmetic set, found on page 1 of the Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond, can be claimed separately for 8 and 2 Medals.
